**Answer: 25 new postcards** (as of 2023-11-30).

**Dates for this fact:**
- 2023-08-11 — 17 new postcards since collecting resumed (saved 2026-10-12T18:16Z).
- 2023-11-30 — 25 new postcards since collecting resumed (saved 2026-10-12T18:43Z).

**Reasoning:** The two notes track the same fact (postcards added since collecting resumed). The 2023-11-30 note is the later one and explicitly says it supersedes the earlier count of 17. So the current value is 25.

**Background:**
- Earlier value: 17 as of 2023-08-11.
- On 2023-11-30 you also reported getting 8 postcards from a local antique shop. The notes do not say whether those 8 are included in the 25, so I have not added them.

The memory does not record any count later than 2023-11-30, so 25 is the most recent figure available.
